query_normalized: statistical power analysis of openly available fmri datasets statistics
rationale: The paper focuses on data preprocessing and quality control procedures (e.g., realignment, denoising) rather than measuring or analyzing statistical power, sample size justification, or the achieved power of openly available fMRI datasets. It addresses the "how to prepare data" methodology but does not provide the empirical baseline, power analysis results, or statistical construct measurements required by the user's specific question.
